result.summary: Found several visual bugs: a raw localization key shown as a section title, truncated restaurant names, and cut-off category chips indicating layout overflow.

issues.description: Section heading displays the raw i18n/localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the proper translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and ensure the localization lookup is wired correctly.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters, and the delivery fee line is cut off at the card edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles or reduce font size, and ensure card content has proper padding/ellipsis so text is not clipped.

issues.description: Category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' chip and a fragment of another chip visible), with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Make the chip row horizontally scrollable with adequate end padding, or wrap/resize chips so all labels are fully visible.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding part of the image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.
